text:
elaine_sales: Quick sync — MerchantOne signed term sheet for enterprise commit. They want 5k RPS sustained for peak windows and can tolerate 200ms p95. Pricing asked for reserved GPU slab + burst credits. Need engineering confirmation on feasibility and recommended autoscale policy.

Tim: Congrats! quick q — is 5k RPS pure generation or includes embeddings/rerank calls? mix matters a lot for GPU sizing.

elaine_sales: Mostly text-gen chat completions (single-turn + context up to 1k tokens). Occasional rerank (10% of requests).

maria_prod: For that mix, baseline estimate: ~6 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs for steady 5k RPS if we keep seq len avg ~350 and batch aggressively. With KV cache and prefix caching we can cut costs ~20%.

devon_infra: Adding: if they want 200ms p95 we need to cap batching latency. Continuous batching target 20ms queue + model latency. That affects batch sizes and throughput per-GPU numbers.

sandeep_se: They asked about burst credits — typical pattern is reserved slab for base, plus pre-warmed burst pool we can allocate for 2x sustained for short windows. How long are their spikes?

elaine_sales: Spikes around launches: 10min bursts 2x, plus daily 30-min mid-day 1.5x. Legal wants guarantees for worst-case for SLA docs.

Tim: Two operational notes: 1) spot-backed burst is cheaper but eviction risk — we can guarantee fallback to a lower-capacity variant with quantized/8-bit model to preserve latency. 2) Need to pin model versions for Dedicated to avoid perf regressions during rollout.

maria_prod: For pricing/commit: propose reserved 6 GPUs + 4 GPU burst pool (spot-backed) and quantized fallback to maintain p95 during eviction. Recommend autoscale policy: scale by RPS over 1min window with cooldown 120s, max burst to pool only when KV cache warm (to avoid coldstart tax).

devon_infra: Also recommend preheat jobs that run KV warmup 5m before expected launches. We can automate via pre-scheduled preheat API. Add runbook steps for ops.

elaine_sales: Security Qs: MerchantOne needs answers for data at rest encryption, KMS integration, and private VPC option. Any blockers for Private deploy?

sandeep_se: No blockers — Private supports customer KMS and VPC peering. We'll need a SOC2 addendum and create an onboarding checklist: KMS key rotation, network ACLs, and audit log retention limits.

Tim: Ops question: what's the failure mode if autoscale can't provision burst in time? We need a fail-open policy: return 429s, and route to lower-cost fallback model with degraded output. Add that to SLA and runbook.

maria_prod: Agree. Add Canary rollout policy: traffic shadowing + 100-user pilot before full roll. Also pin quantization settings per model for reproducible perf.

elaine_sales: Action items: (1) @maria_prod produce a conservative GPU sizing note with numbers (throughput/GPU at avg seq length + p95 targets) by EOD tomorrow. (2) @devon_infra write preheat/runbook snippet and preheat API sample. (3) @sandeep_se draft security onboarding checklist and confirm SOC2 addendum timeline. (4) @tim_sre propose failover SLA text & 429 policy. I'll compile for commercial.

devon_infra: I'll put a sample preheat curl snippet in the runbook: `curl -X POST https://preheat.redwood.example/v1/preheat -d '{"job":"kv_warm","start_in":"5m","duration":"10m"}'` and link to infra playbook.

maria_prod: I'll include perf table: `A100-equiv: 900 rps per GPU @ seq350, p95 180ms (no batching cap)` and cost delta with batching cap. Will include alternative quantized profiles.

sandeep_se: Drafting checklist now. SOC2 addendum ETA: 7 business days to legal review.

Tim: Draft SLA paragraph: "If burst resources not provisioned within 120s, Redwood will attempt model fallback. In case of progressive capacity constraints, Redwood will return 429s for excess requests and notify via webhook. Credits apply per contract." Will refine.

elaine_sales: Perfect. Last Q: do we need any extra observability surface for MerchantOne? they asked for token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency metrics.

maria_prod: Console already supports per-route latency and token cost export. We'll add a dedicated dashboard for the deal and a trace hook for high-p95 alerts.

elaine_sales: Great — thanks team. I'll assemble a package for legal + finance with the proposed reserved+burst pricing, runbook, and security checklist. Ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: Deployment reminder: dedicated-provision request needs RFC ticket and AZ affinity note. Link: https://rfd.redwood.example/requests/9876
